newsitem.title: USA: Thermal moves special meeting to May 22.
newsitem.headline: Thermal moves special meeting to May 22.

text.p: Thermal Industries Inc said Tuesday that a special shareholders meeting to approve a merger with Heat Aquisition Inc, a subsidiary of Heat Inc, has been rescheduled to May 22, from May 13.
Thermal shareholders are facing rival merger bids.

In January, Heat, an affilliate of privately held H.I.G. Investment Group, offered $15 a share cash. Then an unsolicited offer of $19 a share, cash, was made on March 27 by privately-held Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc.

On March 31 Thermal said that it would take no action on the Hicks, Muse offer. It also said its principal shareholders, who own more than half stock, informed it that they would vote for the Heat offer.
Thermal said the meeting date was changed in order to give adequate notice to shareholders and prepare proxy material following the Hicks, Muse offer.
The company said its majority shareholders still back Heat's $15 per share bid.
